usage: jbus queue approve [-h] [--word ID] [--answer NUMBER]
                          [--message THREAD/MESSAGE] [--page SESSION/ENTRY]
                          [--rule N] [--follows SLUG] --sha SHA
                          slug

positional arguments:
  slug

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --word ID             a word `jbus word` kept, by its id
  --answer NUMBER       the answer that closed a question
  --message THREAD/MESSAGE
                        the user's own message in T3 Code
  --page SESSION/ENTRY  the user's own send from a Lavish page
  --rule N              a rule of the home's standing.md, with --follows
  --follows SLUG        the row the user approved that this one follows up
  --sha SHA             the first 12 of that brief's sha256
